title: Handover Analysis for Vehicular Communication with Explainability on the Fly
abstract: arXiv:2608.14820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Handover (HO) management in vehicular networks requires fast and reliable decision-making under highly dynamic conditions. While machine learning (ML) approaches can improve HO detection by capturing complex relationships among various key performance indicators (KPIs), their black-box nature limits interpretability and operator trust. To address this, this paper investigates HO detection from an explainability-on-the-fly perspective using inherently interpretable models based on the functional analysis of variance (fANOVA) framework. The proposed models are evaluated using two real-world operator datasets and compared against a Long Short-Term Memory baseline augmented with post-hoc SHAP explanations. Unlike post-hoc approaches, the proposed framework enables immediate interpretation of model decisions without incurring additional computational overhead. This capability is particularly critical for latency-sensitive vehicular networks

translated_title: 车辆通信中的切换分析及实时可解释性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14820v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：车辆网络中的切换（HO）管理需要在高度动态条件下进行快速可靠的决策。虽然机器学习（ML）方法可以通过捕获各种关键性能指标（KPI）之间的复杂关系来改善切换检测，但其黑盒性质限制了可解释性和操作员的信任。为解决这一问题，本文从实时可解释性的角度，使用基于功能方差分析（fANOVA）框架的内在可解释模型来研究切换检测。所提出的模型使用两个真实世界运营商数据集进行评估，并与一个增强有事后SHAP解释的长短期记忆基线进行比较。与事后方法不同，所提出的框架能够即时解释模型决策，而无需增加额外计算开销。这一能力对于延迟敏感的车辆网络尤为关键。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于fANOVA框架的内在可解释模型，用于车辆网络切换检测，实现了无需额外计算开销的实时决策解释，优于传统事后SHAP方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes inherently interpretable fANOVA-based models for handover detection in vehicular networks, enabling real-time decision explanation without extra computational overhead, outperforming post-hoc SHAP methods.
